items.title: 4.1.5.2 How We Traverse a Tree Using BFS? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of BFS on a tree (PDF 103-104).

blocks.text: Mutawazin binary tree par BFS jis ki jarr 1, bachche 2 aur 3, aur 2 ke neeche patte 4, 5 aur 3 ke neeche 6, 7 (Figure 4.4).

blocks.alt: Baen: binary tree jis ki jarr 1, bachche 2 aur 3, aur patte 4, 5, 6, 7 hain, root, edge, leaves aur height 2 ke labels aur BFS, in-order, pre-order aur post-order tarteebon ke saath. Oopar daen: family tree jis mein Grandparent, Parent1, Parent2 aur Parent1 ke neeche Child1, Child2. Neeche daen: AVL tree jis ki jarr 20, baen bachcha 15 jis ke bachche 10 aur 18, aur daen bachcha 30.
blocks.caption: Tree ki istilahat, traversals, family tree aur AVL tree (topics 4.1.5 se 4.1.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Binary tree mein 1 jarr hai, 4 se 7 patte hain, aur height 2 edges hai. Breadth-first tarteeb level ba level 1 se 7; in-order baen shaakh, jarr, daen shaakh: 4, 2, 5, 1, 6, 3, 7; pre-order pehle jarr: 1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7; post-order aakhir mein jarr: 4, 5, 2, 6, 7, 3, 1. Family tree ki jarr Grandparent hai jis ke do parents hain, aur Parent1 ke do bachche hain. AVL tree mein 15 ke neeche baen shaakh ki height 1 aur daen shaakh 30 ki height 0 hai, to farq sirf 1 hai aur tree mutawazin hai.

blocks.prompt: Tree par BFS mein level ba level nodes dekhne ke liye queue ka kaunsa amal istemal hota hai (MCQ 6)?
blocks.explanation: (c) nodes ko queue mein enqueue karna (aur usi tarteeb se aage se dequeue karna).

items: 7 nodes wale tree par BFS 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 dekhta hai; sab dekhe jane par queue khali.
